::: notes
3:20 · 8 clicks · what a leader manages, not what the package does

- 0 · EDC → `lb` v1
- 1 · `adlb.R` derives `adlb`; parent `lb` v1; the script is tracked too
- 2 · v2 on top; point at v1: still there
- 3 · Statistician reads: storage only, no git, no token
- 4 · Pull back: study 2, its own statistician
- 5 · `pool.R` + set pins both v2s; dashboard reads set v1; safety physician
- 6 · Second programmer edits the same `adlb.R`; nothing pinned moves
- 7 · Release: set v2 + `pool.R`, one commit; v1 stays citable
- 8 · Folders: let the names speak. → "So what did we do differently?"
:::
